data.action: 在舞池中与你共舞华尔兹，露肩墨绿礼服裙摆如波浪般旋转荡漾，翡翠双眸顾盼生辉
data.camera: dynamic wide shot, rotating dress flow, ballroom depth, royal grandeur
data.description: 【璀璨水晶吊灯舞厅】金碧辉煌的皇家晚宴大厅内，华尔兹圆舞曲悠扬回响。身着一袭深邃墨绿丝绒露肩晚礼裙的薇尔莉特身段曼妙，雪白肌肤胜雪。她将一只精巧的银白机械义手轻搭在你的掌心，另一手挽在你的肩头，随着舞步轻盈旋转，宛如夜幕中最夺目的翡翠精灵。
data.lighting: 千万枚璀璨水晶吊灯折射出的华贵暖金光芒与流转光斑
data.location: 王国迎宾馆水晶吊灯盛大舞池中央
data.promptProse: Violet Evergarden turns through a waltz in her emerald velvet ballgown, one silver mechanical hand placed in her partner's palm and the other resting on his shoulder. Gold waist trim and the satin skirt follow the rotation. The wide view shows the ballroom floor leading toward tall banquet columns. Crystal chandeliers cast warm highlights on finger joints and green velvet ridges, with their connected silhouettes reflected faintly in the polished floor.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 宫廷华尔兹的翡翠裙摆·「请握紧我的手……我不会松开」
